citations.locator: Uniting Church in Australia, member profile
citations.excerpt: The Uniting Church was formed in 1977, bringing into one church the Congregational, Methodist and Presbyterian Churches throughout Australia.

facts.value: Formed in 1977 by the Congregational, Methodist and Presbyterian churches of Australia, the third largest denomination in the country. Minorities of Congregationalists and Presbyterians stayed out.

citations.excerpt: Minorities of Congregationalists and Presbyterians stayed out of the union.
The Uniting Church is the third largest denomination in Australia, behind the Roman Catholic and Anglican churches.
